# Cncf Vcluster Reviewer

Review vCluster using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Distribution category. vCluster lets you create fully functional but virtual Kubernetes clusters. Each vCluster runs inside a namespace of another Kubernetes cluster. Using vCluster is much cheaper than creating separate full-blown clusters and it offers better multi-tenancy and isolation compared to regular namespaces.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
